rust_summary: a dedicated server's online mode, listening port and proxy forwarding (`native_online_mode`, `native_server_port`, `native_proxy_forwarding`).
doc_summary: `native_online_mode()` is the dedicated server's `online-mode`; `native_server_port()` the port it listens on (`server-port`, or the `--port` it started with); `native_proxy_forwarding()` is `"velocity"` when it takes its players from a Velocity proxy with `forwarding.secret` (offline mode only) and `"none"` otherwise. The secret is never returned. All three are None off a dedicated server and before it listens. Bundles need "hooks": @API:server_settings@.
